company.name: The University of Texas at San Antonio

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Member of Data Visualization laboratory led by Dr. Kay A Robbins (2005-2009). Analysis and visualization of high-throughput datasets. Individual work included proposing, implementing and testing new algorithms for analysis and navigation through very long noisy datasets, including prototype implementation and testing using Matlab. Assisted in writing papers and creating posters for presentations of team’s research accomplishments. 
Member of Cryptography laboratory led by Dr. Anthony Chronopoulos (2003 – 2004). Duties included testing, debugging, optimizing and measuring performance of a distributed public key generation algorithm. Significantly increased algorithm performance by eliminating costly operations. Algorithm implemented in C using openSSL and executed in Linux environment. Some prototypes were implemented in Matlab.
